thread:
Maya: Thanks everyone for the all-hands turnout. Dropping a short follow-up thread to capture the live questions we promised to clarify and to assign owners. Please confirm or update.

Theo: Quick clarifier: when we said 'regional burst capacity' in the roadmap, is that a per-customer toggle or a global pool?

Maya: Good question. It's a per-account setting that can be enabled by ops for Dedicated; hosted customers will have auto-burst managed by region. We'll add wording to the GA doc.

Riley: I'll take the GA doc update. Planning doc here: https://internal.redwood/ga/dedicated-burst. Owner: @Riley.

Zoe: From live Qs: can customers opt out of prefix caching? A few compliance teams asked.

Theo: It will be opt-out at route level; we'll surface a per-route flag in Dedicated and a global toggle in the admin UI. Owner: @Theo to draft the flag spec.

Maya: Noted. Also asked live: what telemetry will be included in exportable logs for Private deployments?

Zoe: Private logs will include request id, model id, route id, latency, and quantization profile used; no prompt text by default. I'll confirm with security and post a short FAQ blurb. Owner: @Zoe. ETA: 3 business days.

ops-bot: FYI 15: New GA checklist item added: security review confirmation required. Link: https://internal.redwood/tasks/2154321000.

Riley: Small infra ask 15: can we add a snippet showing per-route fallback config in the runtime quickstart? Proposed example:```json
{"route": "/chat","fallback": {"enabled": true, "priority": ["redwood-small","redwood-medium"]}}
```

Theo: That looks good. I'll review and add notes about model compatibility for function-calling.

Maya: Action list I'm capturing 15: please react with :white_check_mark: if it's correct.

- GA doc updates for regional burst and FAQ: owner @Riley 15 ETA 1w.
- Per-route fallback flag spec: owner @Theo 15 ETA 1w.
- Private logs FAQ blurb (fields + privacy): owner @Zoe 15 ETA 3d.
- Runtime quickstart snippet for fallback: owner @Riley + @Theo 15 ETA 4d.

Riley: Adding one more from the huddle 15: request for an internal playbook for sales explaining Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs (cost, latency, SLA). Can product/sales pair on that?

Maya: Yes 15 Sales and Product to pair. Owner: @Theo + Sales. ETA: next Wed.

Zoe: I'll also add a sentence in the FAQ about how Dedicated GA affects hosted customers (short answer: Hosted keeps existing contracts; migration is optional).

Theo: I'll put together a 2-line marketing blurb for comms and share here by EOB.

Maya: Thanks all. If there are other follow-ups from the live Q&A not captured, drop them here or ping me.

ops-bot: Reminder 15 please complete the post-ah feedback survey: https://internal.redwood/surveys/ah-2154321000.
